# Change Order Proposal: CRM Connector Addition

**To:** Client Sponsor
**Re:** Change Order – CRM Connector (Additional Scope)

## Background
The original signed scope covers the reporting dashboard only. The client has requested an additional CRM connector, which is not included in the original fee and therefore requires a separate change order.

## Requested Work
Development and integration of a CRM connector, added to the existing dashboard scope.

## Price
| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Estimated Effort | 40 hours |
| Rate | $175/hour |
| **Proposed Fixed Fee** | **$7,000** |

This is offered as a fixed change fee rather than time-and-materials billing.

## Client Dependency
Client must provide sandbox credentials before work can begin. Delays in providing credentials will delay the schedule below.

## Schedule Impact
Once written approval is received **and** sandbox credentials are provided, the connector work is estimated to add **two weeks** to the project timeline. This is an estimate only and does not constitute an approved calendar date; actual duration may vary based on credential timing and integration complexity.

## Approval Required
Per the governing agreement, work on this connector will not begin until the Sponsor provides **written approval** of this change order. No effort will be billed or scheduled prior to that approval.

## Decision Requested
Please indicate one of the following:

☐ **Approved** – Proceed with CRM connector at $7,000 fixed fee; two-week schedule impact acknowledged (post-credential receipt).

☐ **Declined** – Do not proceed; original dashboard scope remains unchanged.

**Sponsor Signature:** ______________________
**Date:** ______________________

Please return signed approval and sandbox credentials together to begin the two-week estimated timeline.
